name: Electrical Systems Technology Diploma (D35130)
sourceWorkbook: Cape Fear CC: 2024–25 Programs of Study list (credentials, credit totals, CIP 46.0302), the June/July 2026 announcements of the North Campus evening sections (ELC 112 T/Th and ELC 113 M/W 5:30–8:10 PM), the Job Training Electrical Apprenticeship page, the 2026–27 term dates; course hours and credits from the NCCCS Combined Course Library; sequences laid out to the credit totals — compiled 2026-10-22
note: Three terms over twelve months, 40 credits (the college's total; an undated college list says 37): the first year of the AAS with ELC 138 and ELC 213 in the 10-week summer. Sequence from the NCCCS standard laid out to the college's published credit total; not yet confirmed against the catalog's program of study (catalog.cfcc.edu was unreachable on 2026-10-22). Class size not published.
weeklyHoursNote: Term hours per student are the catalog's weekly contact hours × 16 (the 16-week basis), whatever the term's length: the sessions carry them, the posted days, times and rooms place them. Hours and credits are the NCCCS course standard's; ELC 112 and ELC 113 sit on the college's announced evening sections, every other course carries its hours with no section on record; clinical hours are zero in every course.
